This point is open ocean in the South Pacific, so the surface type is Water. The elevation is an estimate from typical ocean-floor depth, not a lookup of actual depth data.

- **Location:** The point lies on the west flank of the East Pacific Rise. The ridge crest at this latitude is near 109°W, about 16° of longitude (roughly 1,750 km) to the east.
